hero.body: A Hindu temple and heritage centre in Norval, Halton Hills — just minutes from Brampton and Georgetown — for worship, festivals and Sanatan Dharma across the GTA and Southern Ontario.

about.title: Hindu temple in Norval, Ontario
about.p1: Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre is a Hindu temple and cultural home in Norval, Halton Hills. Dedicated to Shri Radha Sarveshwar, we welcome devotees from across the Greater Toronto Area for worship, festivals, and community.
about.p2: Our purpose is to preserve and share Sanatan Dharma — a place where families can gather, children can grow in culture, and visitors can find peace.
about.imageAlt: Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre mandir building and grounds in Norval, Ontario

pandit.name: Pandit Mahesh Kumar Acharya
pandit.body: Pandit Mahesh Kumar Acharya serves as the resident pandit of Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre. He leads the daily aarti and puja, festival celebrations and family ceremonies, and guides devotees in the traditions of Sanatan Dharma with warmth and devotion.
pandit.imageAlt: Pandit Mahesh Kumar Acharya wearing a marigold garland and a traditional cap

construction.title: Turning a house into our mandir
construction.body: We are converting a farmhouse on Tenth Line into Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre. The mandir is open for darshan with limited capacity while the work continues.

renovationStart.title: Renovation begins
renovationStart.body: We bought a 1-acre farmhouse on Tenth Line and began converting it: a larger hall for the darbar, a langar kitchen in the garage, two new washrooms and an expanded patio.

limitedOpening.title: Mandir opens with limited capacity
limitedOpening.body: Devotees are welcome for darshan in limited numbers while renovation continues.

murtiArrival.title: 22 murtis arrive from Jaipur
murtiArrival.body: Twenty-two murtis shipped from Jaipur, India arrived safely at the mandir.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.intro: Seva is at the heart of the mandir. Give a few hours a week or help during festivals — every helping hand matters as we build Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre together.

templeSeva.title: Temple seva
templeSeva.body: Help with daily darshan, aarti preparation, flowers and keeping the mandir clean.

festivals.title: Festivals & events
festivals.body: Set up, decorate and welcome devotees during Navratri, Diwali and other utsavs.

youth.body: Support bhajan, language and culture programs for children and youth.

outreach.body: Share updates, take photos and help spread the word across the GTA.

serviceArea.title: A Hindu temple near Brampton and Halton Hills
serviceArea.body: Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre is on Tenth Line North in Norval, between Brampton and Georgetown. Devotees come from across Peel, Halton, the Greater Toronto Area and Southern Ontario for darshan, puja and festivals.
